Notes

18 notes templates

Flowing pages with links, checklists and blocks.

Meeting notesAttendees, agenda, decisions and action items.
Project planGoals, scope, milestones, risks and tasks in one page.
Decision recordContext, options, the decision and what follows from it.
RetrospectiveWhat went well, what didn’t, what to try next.
Weekly reviewWins, blockers and next week’s priorities.
Spec / PRDProblem, goals, requirements, open questions and timeline.
1:1 meetingA running conversation: check-in, topics, feedback and follow-ups.

Book notesWhy you read it, the big ideas, favourite quotes and what you'll do.
Interview notesA structured record of a candidate or customer conversation.
Bug reportSteps to reproduce, expected vs actual, and the fix.

RecipeIngredients, method and notes for next time.
Journal entryA calm daily page: gratitude, highlights and tomorrow.
Client callWho was there, what they need, what you agreed and who follows up.
Weekly plannerTop three priorities and a plan for each day.
Goals and key resultsAn objective, measurable key results and the work to get there.
